mechanism_narrative: EGFR+FGFR1 forced-proximity novokine with flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å) biases signaling by enabling transphosphorylation between EGFR and FGFR1 kinase domains, synergistically activating the shared SHC1→GRB2:SOS1→RAS→MAPK and FRS2→GAB1→PI3K→AKT signaling axes. PLCG1 is sterically excluded due to the ~266 aa ECD asymmetry (EGFR ECD=621 aa vs FGFR1 ECD=355 aa), which creates a tilted co-clustered geometry that PLCG1's PH-SH2-SH2-SH3 domain architecture cannot bridge. This biased output (MAPK↑, AKT↑, PLCγ↓) upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN) and metabolic regulators (PPARGC1A, SLC2A4) while suppressing aged stress/inflammatory markers (EGR1, FOS, JUN, TXNIP, IL32, CDKN2A) — a transcriptional shift from aged toward young muscle phenotype.
